events.title: Tupac Shakur: 30 Years On
events.blurb: On this day in 1996, iconic rapper Tupac Shakur was tragically shot dead in Las Vegas.

angles.name: Remembering Tupac
angles.copy: Thirty years ago, the music world lost a legend. Tupac Shakur's impact on hip-hop and culture remains undeniable. What's your favourite track?

events.title: Remembering Jimi Hendrix
events.blurb: This day marks the 56th anniversary of the death of rock legend Jimi Hendrix in 1970.

angles.name: Hendrix's Legacy
angles.copy: 56 years since we lost the incomparable Jimi Hendrix. His groundbreaking guitar work changed music forever. What's your favourite Hendrix moment?

events.title: Abbey Road Turns 57
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic 'Abbey Road' album on this day in 1969.

angles.name: Iconic Album Anniversary
angles.copy: It's 57 years since The Beatles gave us 'Abbey Road'. That album cover, those tracks... pure magic. What's your go-to song from the record?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde Turns 75
events.blurb: Chrissie Hynde, frontwoman of The Pretenders, celebrates her 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Chrissie
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 75th birthday to the incredible Chrissie Hynde! Her distinctive voice and attitude have fronted The Pretenders for decades. Which Pretenders track are you playing today?

events.title: Liam Gallagher Turns 54
events.blurb: Former Oasis frontman Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Liam
angles.copy: Our kid turns 54 today! Happy Birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher. What's your favourite track from the iconic frontman?

events.title: 'Imagine' Turns 51
events.blurb: John Lennon released his seminal album 'Imagine' on this day in 1975.

angles.name: Imagine Album Anniversary
angles.copy: 51 years ago, John Lennon gave us 'Imagine'. More than just an album, it's a timeless message of peace and hope. What does this album mean to you?

events.title: iPod: 25 Years Since Launch
events.blurb: Apple launched the very first iPod on this day in 2001, revolutionising portable music.

angles.name: iPod Turns 25
angles.copy: Remember the click wheel? Today marks 25 years since the original iPod dropped, changing how we listen to music forever. How many songs did you cram onto yours?

events.title: Happy James Bond Day
events.blurb: James Bond Day marks the anniversary of the premiere of the first Bond film, 'Dr. No', in 1962.

angles.name: Bond, James Bond
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! From iconic gadgets to unforgettable theme tunes, 007 has been thrilling us for decades. Who's your favourite Bond and why?

events.title: John Lennon Would Have Been 86
events.blurb: Legendary musician John Lennon would have celebrated his 86th birthday today.

angles.name: Remembering John Lennon
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we remember the visionary John Lennon. His music and message continue to inspire. What's his most impactful song for you?

events.title: John Cleese Turns 87
events.blurb: Legendary comedian and actor John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday John Cleese
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the brilliant John Cleese! From Monty Python to Fawlty Towers, his comedy is truly timeless. What's your favourite Cleese moment?

events.title: The White Album Turns 58
events.blurb: The Beatles released their self-titled double album, commonly known as 'The White Album', on this day in 1968.

angles.name: White Album Anniversary
angles.copy: It's 58 years since The Beatles unleashed the sprawling masterpiece that is 'The White Album'. A truly eclectic mix of tracks. Which one is on your playlist today?

events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury
events.blurb: This day marks the 35th anniversary of the death of Queen frontman Freddie Mercury in 1991.

angles.name: Freddie's Legacy
angles.copy: 35 years ago, we lost the incomparable Freddie Mercury. His voice, his stage presence, his legacy – forever etched in rock history. What's your favourite Queen anthem?

events.title: 'Rubber Soul' Turns 61
events.blurb: The Beatles released their groundbreaking album 'Rubber Soul' on this day in 1965.

angles.name: Rubber Soul Anniversary
angles.copy: 61 years since The Beatles shifted gears with 'Rubber Soul'. This album was a game-changer for pop music. What's your top track from it?

events.title: Remembering John Lennon
events.blurb: This day marks the 46th anniversary of the tragic death of John Lennon in 1980.

angles.name: Lennon's Lasting Impact
angles.copy: 46 years ago today, the world lost John Lennon. His music and his message of peace continue to resonate globally. What does his legacy mean to you?
